rationale: Theresa is building RemotelyGood, an AI-powered job board for social-impact roles, and explicitly leverages AI tools as a non-engineer to create civic products. intro_message: Theresa, meet Chinguun Ganbaatar—a full-stack engineer at Starch who works across Python and TypeScript and might be a good sounding board as you scale RemotelyGood's AI-powered job board.
